title: Concept: Possible an Ansible extra variable carrying a password in source
description: an Ansible extra variable carrying a password places a credential directly in a tool invocation. The value then propagates through build logs, image layers and copied commands, so it must be treated as exposed the moment it is committed.
applicability: Scripts, Makefiles, CI definitions and runbooks that may contain an Ansible extra variable carrying a password.
risk: Use of the credential through the tool it was meant for, by anyone who reads the script or the log; HIGH severity.
